title: Classificações de Convicção e Conjuração — rótulos de cores da p.102
scopeLimits: This proposal covers only the eight numbered color labels on page 102. Original source fonts, sizes, row positions, source artwork, and color-die icons remain unchanged.

A revisão preserva os nomes de cor em caixa alta e os símbolos de dado inline. Molduras locais ajustadas mantêm cada rótulo em uma linha sem colisões; as cores impressas no diagrama original permanecem em inglês.

All eight current candidates pass Copyfit V3 EXACT at 100% and 200%, with no measured frame overflow or neighboring-row intersection. An isolated immutable-snapshot PDF export verified all eight row records and the example paragraph. The Rich Block Editor was not opened; all candidates remain unapproved and no final PT-BR translation or Payload review record was written.

note: Each source label is one visual PDF baseline, measured from extracted source line geometry. Four live PageRenderer variants were compared at 100% and 200%; sentence case alone resolves four uppercase-only wraps, while the full Turquesa and Vermelho still wrap. The compact forms Turq. and Verm. produce one visual row and fit their immutable source frames at both zooms. Existing color cube artwork remains in source order beside the labels.

revisions.note: Applied the new mandatory line-count target to all eight source rows.
